svg.title: B04-E Vector Database and Embeddings — self-reviewed production candidate v03
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction traced and self-checked against the locked approved reference. Database is pure white, vector badge is light grey, outlines are ink, details are sage, and the vector path is ember. Recoloured 2026-07-24 to the Grounded AI Practice palette. viewBox normalised from the original 1254x1254 to the set's standard 512x512 via a single wrapping scale(0.4082935) transform on 2026-07-24 — no individual path coordinates were altered, so the rendered shape is pixel-identical to before, just consistent with the rest of the icon set's coordinate space.
